blends.name: Rare Pin
blends.desc:
Blend 3 Common Pins to get this Rare Pin!

Pins are won from giveaways during NFTOPIA conventions. Utilities include extra giveaway entries for all Bountyblok contests, access to each convention's "Rare" Collector's Badge drop, and more in the future!

NFTOPIA 5 is August 16-17, 2025! https://nftopia.weebly.com
